title.zh: 将哥打巴托省 Banisilan 市镇 Carugmanan 描笼涯的 Banisilan 国立中学的 Carugmanan 附属校分离，改设为独立的同名国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Banisilan National High School – Carugmanan Annex in Barangay Carugmanan, Municipality of Banisilan, Province of Cotabato From the Banisilan National High School, Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as Carugmanan National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Banisilan National High School – Carugmanan Annex in Barangay Carugmanan, Municipality of Banisilan, Province of Cotabato From the Banisilan National High School, Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as Carugmanan National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Carugmanan của Trường Trung học Banisilan Quốc gia tại Barangay Carugmanan, Đô thị Banisilan, Tỉnh Cotabato khỏi Trường Trung học Banisilan Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Carugmanan Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Carugmanan ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Banisilan แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Carugmanan เทศบาล Banisilan จังหวัด Cotabato ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Banisilan แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Carugmanan แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Carugmanan, Sekolah Menengah Banisilan Nasional di Barangay Carugmanan, Kotamadya Banisilan, Provinsi Cotabato dari Sekolah Menengah Banisilan Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Carugmanan Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Carugmanan, Sekolah Menengah Banisilan Kebangsaan di Barangay Carugmanan, Perbandaran Banisilan, Wilayah Cotabato daripada Sekolah Menengah Banisilan Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Carugmanan Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: The Banisilan National High School – Carugmanan Annex in Barangay Carugmanan, Municipality of Banisilan, Province of Cotabato is hereby separated from the Banisilan National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Carugmanan National High School.
All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Banisilan National High School – Carugmanan Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Carugmanan National High School.

The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Carugmanan National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year’s appropriation of the Banisilan National High School – Carugmanan Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
The Secretary of Education shall issue rules and regulations necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
